source_record.title: Pharmacy Dispenser - Evening Shift
source_record.description:
In our pharmacy, every day is about combining pace with precision, always keeping patients at the heart of everything we do. We work in a fast-moving, agile environment where accuracy is paramount, flexibility is essential, and no two days are the same. You will be part of a dedicated team that thrives under pressure, adapts quickly, and takes pride in making a genuine difference to patients’ lives

About the role:

Working as a Pharmacy dispenser supporting the supply of CMBP in a specialist Private pharmacy. This is a niche role in a growing area. The successful candidate will be working alongside specialist Clinical Pharmacists to make CMBP more accessible for all patients

This role with cover our evening shift starting at 12:00pm-9pm

Key responsibilities:

  • Receiving and validating prescriptions ready for a clinical check.

  • Processing patient information appropriately.

  • Supporting the Responsible Pharmacist & Technicians in the daily operations of the Pharmacist.

  • Being the first point of contact for any queries to the Pharmacy.

  • Maintaining relevant records for the supply of CMBP.

  • Maintaining stock and security of any CMBP on site.

  • Maintaining communication of prescription to the Department of Health to meet Regulatory Requirements.

  • Supporting governance in the Pharmacy to ensure the pharmacy is operating as safely as possible.

Qualifications, skills and experience:

  • A UK qualified Pharmacy dispenser

  • Ideally Undertaken CPD-accredited medical cannabis educational programme. Through this will be provided for the successful candidate

  • Self-motivated individual with high levels of attention to detail, able to work accurately, identifying errors quickly and easily

  • Experience in working in the pharmacy dispensary either primary and/or secondary environment

  • Has attention to detail, patience and the ability to remain calm during stressful situations

  • Excellence in communication skills with staff, patients and other healthcare professionals.

  • Professional, ethical and committed to providing excellent customer care

  • Excellent computer literacy with good working knowledge of office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint

What we offer:

  • Bupa Private Healthcare Scheme

  • 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after one year & 30 after 2 years) + bank holidays

  • 5% matched pension

  • Cycle-to-work scheme

  • Opportunities for development and growth

  • A dynamic and supportive work environment

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.
